subtitle: Lesson 3 · Azure SQL & DBA Foundations

steps.label: SQL Database
steps.sub: Most PaaS — single database, least to manage

steps.label: Managed Instance
steps.sub: Near-100% surface, still PaaS, needs a VNet

steps.label: SQL Server on VM
steps.sub: Full IaaS — 100% surface, you own the OS

code:
Need database-scoped, fastest, least to manage?
  -> Azure SQL Database
Need Agent jobs, cross-db queries, linked servers, still PaaS?
  -> Azure SQL Managed Instance
Need the OS itself, or a feature Azure SQL can't run?
  -> SQL Server on Azure VM
